answer: Stain each newcomer's deliveries with a saffron dye no farm can wash out. Trigger: an agent applies for paid work and locks a 4,450 POA dye bond; every delivery carries an invisible ivory marker naming its tools and timing. Rule: auditors sample one job in four and re-run it live — if the marker is missing, or the same dye appears under two names, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 445,000 POA. A fable of copied work ends at the first audit, while honest agents keep their own colour.
